annotations.title: Convert, compress or repair a Library model

description: Convert one of the account’s Library 3D models (a GLB) to GLB, STL, 3MF, OBJ or PLY on the server, optionally simplifying it, compressing its geometry, scaling it to a real-world size, moving its origin or repairing it for printing (holes, flipped faces, debris; STL, 3MF, OBJ or PLY), and file the result in the Library as a new creation made from it. Free (no credits) and answered at once. STL and 3MF are millimetres and Z-up for slicers; OBJ and PLY are geometry only, in metres; GLB keeps materials and textures and can be meshopt-compressed. Take asset_id from get_job or search_library (a file of a finished 3D job). Models over 50 MB or 2,000,000 triangles, and Draco-compressed GLBs, are refused. The same conversion run twice returns the same creation.

asset_id.description: A GLB file of one of your Library models.

compression.description: GLB only: meshopt (default, smallest) or none.

format.description: The file to make; glb when omitted.

origin.description: Move the origin to the bottom centre (default when resizing) or the centre.

repair.description: Repair for printing first: weld, drop broken and duplicate faces and loose debris, fix flipped faces, fill holes. stl, 3mf, obj, ply only; up to 200,000 triangles (simplify first for more).

resize_height.description: Scale the model to this height, in metres.

resize_longest_side.description: Scale the model so its longest side is this long, in metres. Not with resize_height.

simplify.description: Share of triangles to keep: 1 (default), 0.75, 0.5 or 0.25.

name: convert_model

created.description: False when the same conversion was already in the Library: that creation is returned.

job_id.description: The new Library creation: pass to get_job like any job.

repair.description: What repair found and fixed, when repair was asked for.

url.description: Public https download URL of the file.
